## What Problem Is Being Solved?

Forest and land fires are a recurring environmental challenge in Indonesia. Understanding where hotspots cluster helps authorities prioritize fire prevention and response.

## How It Works

This project applies the **agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm** to satellite-derived hotspot data for Bangka Belitung Islands Province, revealing spatial clusters of fire activity.

## My Role

Researcher and developer of the clustering analysis.

## What Was Produced

Clustering analysis code and results, which also informed a [journal publication](https://github.com/akhiyarwaladi/fire_spot).
